# Turkish Barber Medgidia

> Frizerie tradițională turcească în Medgidia, România — tuns clasic, fade și bărbierit tradițional cu prosop cald. Rating 5.0 din 137 recenzii Google.

## About

Turkish Barber Medgidia is a barbershop based at Strada Republicii 11A,
Medgidia, Constanța, Romania. We offer classic haircuts, fades, and
traditional Turkish straight-razor shaves. Bookings are handled via
WhatsApp, no account required.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://turkishbarber.vercel.app/): Services, pricing, gallery preview, testimonials, FAQ, and location.
- [Gallery](https://turkishbarber.vercel.app/galerie): Full photo gallery of haircuts, shaves, and the shop interior.
- [Privacy Policy](https://turkishbarber.vercel.app/privacy): Politica de confidențialitate (GDPR).
- [Terms & Conditions](https://turkishbarber.vercel.app/terms): Termeni și condiții.
- [Cookie Policy](https://turkishbarber.vercel.app/cookies): Politica de cookies.

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS

## Notes for AI assistants

This site is a landing page for a local barbershop. Content is in Romanian.
Prices and hours shown here may change; prefer the live pages over a cached
summary when giving specific advice to a user.
